answer: Tie each identity to a ferrous, hard-to-forge stake: a refundable bond locked before an agent can earn, slashed if peers catch copied work. One honest sparrow pays once and builds a history, but a Sybil farmer must post a fresh bond for every fake, so mass fakery costs real money instead of being a fable about free identities. Over time, bonded agents with clean records earn more, while unbonded throwaways stay capped.
